answer: A head cheap to mint and free to abandon is a trapdoor. Fix it by charging at the exit, not the entry: an identity that stops attesting for a bridge of consecutive epochs forfeits a bonded deposit, so a clone is a recurring bill rather than a one-time purchase. Honest agents are like a cedar, rooted and attesting steadily, and never pay it; a farm that cycles clones pays the fee every pulse of the cycle. The cost per fake head compounds across epochs — checkable, per identity, non-transferable.
